Setting.bmg:3:
(1/4) Sharing Favourite Stamp Information with Friends

TV no Tomo lets you create a “Favourite Friend” relationship between your Wii and Wii Friends in your Address Book.

You can share programme stamps placed by Favourite Friends, as well as stamps placed by you and your family.
Setting.bmg:4:
(2/4) Information Shared with Favourite Friends

Shared:
• Programmes marked with Favourite Stamps

Not shared:
• Mii name, face and gender
• Email address
• Birth year and other information
Setting.bmg:5:
(3/4) Sending Favourite Stamp Information to Nintendo

To aggregate stamp information by prefecture and show programme popularity, please allow us to send:

• Programmes marked with Favourite Stamps
• The birth year and Mii gender associated with each stamp
• The prefecture selected for the TV guide
Setting.bmg:6:
(4/4) Sending Favourite Stamp Information to Nintendo

The original service notice says Nintendo will keep these details confidential and use them to publish aggregated statistics and improve future services.

It also states that the information sent does not include personal or privacy-related information.

Setting.bmg:64:
(1/5) Request to Share Programme and Viewing Information

To improve future services and publish aggregated statistics such as programme popularity, please review the information described on the following screens. If enabled, this information is sent automatically.
Setting.bmg:65:
(2/5) Information About Programme Details

Your Wii sends information when a programme details screen is opened. Repeated openings of the same screen are counted only once. This information is combined with Favourite Stamp data for regional popularity statistics, and includes the guide region you selected.
Setting.bmg:66:
(3/5) Information About TV Stations and Times

When the TV Remote feature is used to select a TV station or programme directly from the channel, the station and selection time may be sent. The time you press HOME to return to the channel may also be sent. The original service used this information to inform future improvements.
Setting.bmg:67:
(4/5) Privacy Notice

The original service notice says Nintendo will keep submitted information confidential and use it for aggregated statistics and future service improvements. It states that the information does not include personal or privacy-related details.

Use Settings in the lower-left corner to change whether programme-detail and TV-station/time information is sent.
Setting.bmg:68:
(5/5) Important

Favourite Stamp information has a separate sharing setting for each stamp. To change it, open Settings → Favourite Stamps, select a stamp, then choose Stamp Information → Send to Nintendo and select Cooperate or Do Not Cooperate.
